description: Multi-agent orchestration system for Claude Code coordination
reasoning: Orchestration requires agents to edit code, run tests, commit changes, and coordinate via cross-session messages. Permission mode 'ask' is required so agents can receive work assignments and report completion without being blocked by permission mode mismatches.
implementationNote: This file documents permissions needed for reliable orchestration. As of 2026-10-17, Claude Code does not read this file automatically. Set Permission Mode to 'ask' in Claude Code settings manually when working on this project. Future enhancement: Claude Code may read this file at agent startup and apply the recommended permissions.
